actions.description: Local updates and optional owned data-source operation; at least one required. validate references input IDs with validation; failure blocks the entire action. Host additionally checks references, state types, disjoint IDs and budgets. No scripts or arbitrary paths.

uiNode.description: Host additionally enforces UTF-8 byte limits (schema maxLength counts characters), no NUL, 128 nodes/depth8, unique node IDs, declared state and command references. Boolean controls/dynamic bindings use true/false; choices and sliders canonical indices; progress canonical0..100; data selection rowID or empty. Dataset rows total4096/depth8, IDs unique per dataset, cells match columns. Nested scrollView defaults240DIP; root uses viewport. Data selected row must be enabled; splitPane exactly2children and state canonical0..100; sidebarSection/stagingTray state boolean; byte counts exact0..2^53 and free<=total when total known; titlebar actions must reference declared commands. Layout minWidth/minHeight/maxWidth/maxHeight use DIP0..4096; max0 is unbounded. Host enforces min<=nonzero max. flex0..16 only direct stack children. Positive maxHeight containers require scrollView. Narrow viewport takes precedence over requested minimum; constrained horizontal stacks may fall back vertically; defaults preserve previous layout.

uiValidation.description: Lengths count Unicode code points; minLength<=maxLength; required cannot have maxLength0. Incomplete initial/editing values allowed; actions with validate are blocked atomically if a field fails.

uiMenuItem.description: Host enforces globally unique menu IDs, 128 menu/action items total and depth 4.

uiDataSource.description: Directory source reads current pane memory snapshot only, default pageSize64. transferTask reads the extension-owned latest controlled transfer, default/pageSize1, no filter/sort. State keys must be declared; output keys distinct from each other and input/selection keys.
